attacker_pocs.name: named_od_url_growth
attacker_pocs.why: The public XMT scene loader resolves a named OD URL to a four-digit binary ID. The replacement URL is longer than the original URL used to size the new heap buffer, so URL formatting writes beyond its allocation.

role_a_rationale: The fixed stack buffer is replaced with a per-URL heap allocation, allowing ordinary long URL fragments to load. Sizing that allocation from the original URL misses growth when a short symbolic OD name resolves to a longer numeric ID. The patch is a small local change to URL rewriting, and the C PoC reaches it through gf_sm_load_init and gf_sm_load_run.
